name: Guided Ai Product Management
description:
The most comprehensive PM skills plugin available — 83 structured workflows across 9 domains, built natively for Claude Code and compatible with Cursor, Windsurf, and Gemini CLI via MCP.

What makes it different:

Interactive learning — 8 Socratic learning modules that teach PM frameworks by doing, not reading. Practice user interviews with a simulated user, negotiate roadmap trade-offs with conflicting executives, apply RICE scoring to a real backlog. Built for PMs who want to get better, not just get things done.

Vibe coding for PMs — a full suite for PM-builders shipping with AI: write specs optimised for Cursor and Claude Code, plan prototypes, make technical architecture decisions without an engineering background, review AI-generated code for spec compliance, and run pre-launch deployment checklists.

Full coverage — product discovery (Teresa Torres's OST), strategy (9-section canvas, Lean Canvas, Porter's, PESTLE), execution (PRDs, OKRs, sprints, retros), go-to-market (GTM strategy, growth loops, ICP), market research, data analytics (A/B tests, SQL, cohort analysis), and AI product management (responsible AI, model evaluation, prompt engineering).
